sections.text:
In a small mud swamp full of frogs of different sizes, there lived a relatively large frog among his peers. He was very arrogant and boastful about his size, which he considered exceptional.

The arrogant frog would always stand on a high rock, puff out his chest to appear larger, and mock the little frogs, saying: “Look at me! I am the biggest and strongest animal in this swamp, and perhaps even in the whole forest!”

Sometimes the little frogs believed him and feared him, and he enjoyed this feeling of control and false greatness.

One day, while the arrogant frog was sleeping, a very large and powerful bull came to drink from the swamp water.

The bull was the size of a mountain compared to the frogs, and with his heavy steps he almost ran over a group of small frogs that were playing near the shore.

The little frogs ran terrified towards the rock on which the big frog was sleeping, to wake him up and tell him what they saw.

"Sir! Sir! We have just seen a terrifying monster! It is the largest animal imaginable, with huge horns and feet that shake the earth!" said the little frogs, trembling.

The arrogant frog opened his eyes lazily, looked at them with contempt and said: “A huge monster? The largest animal in existence? Nonsense! There is no animal larger than me!”

A little frog responded with fear: “I swear to you, sir, he is hundreds of times bigger than you!”

The arrogant frog was very angry that they belittled him, and said defiantly: “Hundreds of times bigger than me? Impossible! Look at me now and I will show you how big I am!”

The frog took a deep breath of air, filled his lungs and body with it, and inflated like a balloon until it became twice its size.

"Was this monster that big?" asked the little frogs, panting.

The little frogs shook their heads no and said: “No, sir, it was much, much bigger than that!”

The arrogant frog felt angry, so he took a longer and deeper breath, and inflated his body with greater force until his eyes became bulging and his skin was almost torn.

He said in a choked voice: “What about now? Surely I’m older than him now, right?”

The frogs stepped back from his terrifying appearance and said, “No, sir, please stop. The monster is still bigger than you, like a mountain, and you are like a pebble!”

The frog went crazy, and he could not accept the idea of ​​an animal larger than him, so he decided to collect all the air in the swamp to inflate more than ever before.

He started drawing air and pulling and pulling, inflating and swelling, and his skin expanded and became thin and transparent due to the abundance of air inside him!
The frogs said terrified: “Stop, sir! It will explode!”

But the arrogant frog did not listen to the advice, and continued to forcefully and stubbornly suck the air to prove to them that he was the greatest.

Suddenly, his body could no longer bear this enormous pressure, and undesirable consequences happened.

“Boom!”

The arrogant frog exploded and its body parts were scattered everywhere, and his miserable life ended because of vanity, pride, and stupid competition!
Thus, arrogant people learn that every human being has a limit and a destiny that he must adhere to, and that false boasting and trying to appear as something we do not have always leads to quick destruction.
